title: Deep Rays Update
description: Dive into the magical world of the Deep Rays Update, a mod waiting to be discovered.
body: Dive into the magical world of the Deep Rays Update, a mod waiting to be discovered. What are you waiting for? Want to see new structures, blocks, minerals, and much more? Join your minecraft world and be ready to face new challenges new recipes achievements and much more.The only limit is your imagination so use it to build mine and explore this fantastic world, the world of minecraft. Let's try it. find a new structure, 2 new ores and explore, create and let your imagination be in the world
